Places in Algeria that don’t feel real. 🇩🇿 The endless red dunes and towering rock formations of Tadrart. The remarkably preserved Roman ruins of Djemila, surrounded by mountains. The lush green forests of Seraïdi, overlooking the Mediterranean. And Constantine, a city built dramatically across cliffs and deep gorges, connected by bridges suspended high above the landscape.
